summary: Converts SOP 3D geometry to POP geometry. SOP point, vertex, and primitive attributes are converted to POP attributes, with common renames such as uv to Tex, Cd to Color, width to LineWidth, and pscale to PointScale.

key_params.note: How to handle polygons with five or more points

key_params.name: mesh
key_params.note: How to convert SOP mesh primitives

key_params.name: inputcolorspace
key_params.note: Color-space interpretation for incoming color data

key_concepts: SOP geometry to POP geometry bridge
SOP point, vertex, and primitive attribute conversion
attribute renames: uv to Tex and Cd to Color
width to LineWidth and pscale to PointScale
triangles and quads preserved as POP primitives
mesh conversion to quads, rows, or ignored output
common_gotchas: POPs do not support polygons with five or more points; choose ignore, triangulate, or closed line strip behavior.
SOP meshes do not preserve row/column dimension automatically; use Dimension POP when that structure matters.
SOP primitive types like sphere and rare Bezier/NURBS forms are converted as points without primitives.
